categories.rationale: Corrects an ineffective unit test to ensure regressions in SRD weight-based eviction tie-breaking are caught. The existing test passed 'utxo_pool' rather than 'mixed_weight_pool' and had a high weight threshold, allowing regressions of #33223 to pass undetected.
